Planner catalogue

Many algorithms.
A common place to work.

Research methods, model-based planners, sampling control, and learned integrations share the surrounding task and experiment tooling.

MethodFamilyRole in the stack
MDOCOur researchModel-based diffusion with CBF projections inside dynamics rollouts.
MD-COASOur researchiALM soft feasibility, CFS correction, and adaptive constraint scheduling.
2GOOur researchActive geometry shapes refinement and reverse stochastic exploration.
MGAOur researchLearned proposals and feedback-conditioned motion–impedance refinement.
MBDModel-based generationKnown dynamics and Monte Carlo score estimates, without demonstrations.
EB-MBDModel-based generationEmerging barriers retain informative candidates under constraints.
MPPISampling MPCCost-weighted control samples for receding-horizon optimization.
DIAL-MPCModel-based generationDiffusion-inspired annealing for online control-sequence refinement.
ATACOMContact / constraintsTangent-space actions on an augmented constraint manifold.
ISSAContact / constraintsDerivative-free action filtering through implicit safe-set search.
PegasusFlowModel-based generationRolling denoising with weighted spline-basis trajectory updates.
DPCCLearned diffusionLearned trajectory diffusion with model-based projection and tightening.
SafeDiffuserLearned diffusionCBF corrections during learned trajectory denoising.

MD-COAS uses the historical CFS-MBD implementation. 2go and twogo are aliases. Dependencies, devices, and checkpoints vary by method; consult the compatibility and planner references.
